discription: A gentle, pulsing pad sound with a low-pass filter and an LFO for amplitude modulation, creating a subtle, evolving texture.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseFreq=0.5, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000;var sig, lfo, env;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.8, 0.7, 1.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);lfo = SinOsc.ar(pulseFreq).range(0.7, 1.0);sig = Saw.ar(freq);sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);sig = sig * amp * env * lfo;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
